title: Read a simulated component's status
description: The Simulation page lists every component a simulator serves beside a node. Open one to see where it is served and what has reached it.

steps.caption: The Simulation page shows the simulated fleet, live.
One row per simulated component. Hits counts how often collection has reached it.
Its status says where it is served, and how often collection has reached it.
Close the drawer to return to the fleet.
Back on the fleet, every simulated component in view.
